modules.title: Anatomy, physiology, and pathology
modules.summary: Breast anatomy for positioning relevance, tissue composition and density concepts, findings vocabulary at technologist level, and BI-RADS/MQSA assessment–density awareness — without teaching independent image interpretation. Honest beta status throughout.

modules.title: Image production: acquisition, quality, and radiation
modules.summary: How the mammography beam is made and shaped, how FFDM and DBT differ, how technologists judge image quality, and how to talk about radiation risk without inventing numbers.

modules.title: Imaging informatics, displays, and CAD
modules.summary: Technologist-level PACS, RIS, EHR, and DICOM basics; which displays may be used to interpret mammograms and why display calibration matters; CAD and AI as decision support, not replacement; and data integrity, original-image retention, and patient identification in a digital workflow. Built from eCFR, the 2023 MQSA final rule, FDA guidance, NCI PDQ, NLM MeSH, and link-only DICOM.

modules.title: MQSA quality standards
modules.summary: The federal rules that shape everyday mammography work: certification and accreditation, technologist qualifications, reports and results timelines, labeling, records, the outcomes audit, required policies, and equipment QC basics.

modules.title: Patient care and communication
modules.summary: Technologist-level patient communication plus risk/epidemiology, signs and history, and treatment terminology: preparing patients, explaining the exam, screening versus diagnostic purpose, results boundaries, infection control, breast cancer incidence and risk factors, symptom recognition, history documentation, and surgical/nonsurgical definitions.

modules.title: Positioning and procedures
modules.summary: Standard CC/MLO purpose and sourced evaluation ideas, compression purpose, labeling, screening vs diagnostic pathways, implants and displacement views, and purpose-level additional views — with honest beta status for criteria that need qualified review.

modules.title: Procedures and QC depth
modules.summary: Fills Stage 3 gaps: federal-sourced technologist/physicist QC purposes (without redistributing ACR DMQC procedures), additional-view terminology and purpose-level localization, and interventional consent/time-out from AHRQ Universal Protocol summaries.

modules.title: QC principles and regulations depth
modules.summary: Goes beyond the MQSA survey module: EQUIP inspection feedback loops, personnel layers (MQSA vs ARRT link-only), consumer complaints and records lifecycle under 21 CFR 900, and technologist-level QC principles—categories, frequency rationale, and corrective-action timing—without redistributing ACR Digital Mammography QC Manual procedures.
